test.name: tsdb_backup_health
test.description: Validates TSDB writer health metrics are present in metrics snapshot, ensuring backup-related observability for the MetricsRecorder flush pipeline

required_metrics.name: writer_health.consecutive_failures
required_metrics.description: Number of consecutive TSDB flush failures (0 = healthy)

required_metrics.name: writer_health.buffer_size
required_metrics.description: Number of metric samples queued in retry buffer (0 = flushed)
